title: Cash Case 2017 Bowman Draft REFRACTOR 1st Chrome #BDC-198 - Cincinnati Reds
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2017 Bowman Draft sports trading card features Cash Case, a player from the Cincinnati Reds team in Major League Baseball (MLB). The card is part of the base set and has a card number of BDC-198. It also has a chrome parallel/variety, making it a great addition to any sports trading card collection. 

The card is manufactured by Bowman and is not autographed. It is perfect for fans of the Cincinnati Reds and Cash Case, as well as collectors of sports trading cards. Get this card now and add it to your collection!
